snippet.title: March of Giants: Gameplay Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
For the first time, gameplay from March of Giants is revealed. Giants collide, strategies unfold, and every move matters. This is where the journey begins.

Closed Alpha runs Sept 2-14. Request access on Steam and join us on the battlefield.

Learn more about March of Giants: https://playmog.games/website
Request Closed Alpha access: https://playmog.games/Steam 

FOLLOW US ON SOCIAL
X: https://x.com/amazongames
IG: https://www.instagram.com/amazongames/
